task.skinGen:
Write settings for the theme editor of a chat page as JSON.

The user describes the look:
{{request}}

Output one JSON object and nothing else:
{"name": "…", "gen": {"<group id>": {"<item id>": value}}}

- name: a short name for this theme, in the language of the description.
- Use only the group ids and item ids listed below. Items that are left out keep their defaults.
- color: "#RRGGBB" or "#RRGGBBAA". num: a plain number in the unit shown. switch: true or false. pick: one of the ids in the brackets. text: a string.
- "theirs" is the character's side, "mine" is the user's side.
